view: PA frontal chest radiograph (erect, scapulae largely retracted from lung fields)
technical_quality: Adequate. Good inspiration (about 9-10 posterior ribs visible), no significant rotation (medial clavicle ends roughly equidistant from the spinous processes), adequate penetration (thoracic spine visible through the cardiac silhouette). Whole thorax including both costophrenic angles included. No L/R marker seen apart from a small arrow icon at the top-right corner of the image; conventional orientation assumed.

devices.location: patient's right axilla / right lateral chest wall soft tissue, projected lateral to the right upper ribs at approximately the level of the anterior 2nd-4th ribs, outside the lung
top-right corner of the image, outside the patient

abnormalities.finding: Cluster of multiple surgical clips in the axillary/lateral chest wall soft tissues (post-surgical change, likely prior axillary lymph node dissection); no associated lung or bone lesion
Mild asymmetry of the breast shadows (right breast shadow appears slightly smaller than the left), possibly related to prior right breast surgery; both breast shadows are present
Tiny punctate dense dot (about 0.1-0.2 cm) lateral to the left hilum in the mid zone, most likely a vessel seen end-on or a tiny calcified granuloma; no definite pulmonary nodule or mass identified

description_zh: 正面PA胸部X光，吸氣充足、無明顯旋轉、穿透度適當。右側腋下及側胸壁軟組織可見多枚金屬手術夾，符合先前手術（如右腋下淋巴結廓清）之術後變化，兩側乳房陰影皆存在但右側略小；未見胸管、中心靜脈導管或心律調節器。兩側肺野清晰，肺紋理正常，未見明確結節、腫塊、實質化或肋膜積液，兩側肋膈角銳利，僅左中肺野見一極小點狀緻密影，多考慮為血管端面或微小鈣化肉芽腫。心臟大小正常，縱膈與肺門輪廓正常，氣管居中，骨骼未見骨折或破壞性病灶。
